title: Information bound for Bob's special-coordinate bit
statement:
Fix a positive integer $n$ and a deterministic communication protocol $p$ for disjointness inputs of length $n$, with communication complexity $\ell$. Sample an input from the hard distribution conditioned on the event that Alice's and Bob's generated sets are disjoint; let $M$ denote the transcript that $p$ produces on the sampled input pair, let $T$ denote the special coordinate, let $Y_T$ denote Bob's bit at the special coordinate, and let $(T, X_{\le T}, Y_{>T})$ denote Bob's special-coordinate conditioning variable. Then the conditional mutual information between $Y_T$ and $M$ given $(T, X_{\le T}, Y_{>T})$ satisfies
\[
I\!\left(Y_T : M \mid T,\, X_{\le T},\, Y_{>T}\right) \le \frac{\ell \, \log 2}{n}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic disjointness protocol of length n
communication complexity of p is ℓ (entering the bound)
measure is the hard distribution conditioned on disjointness
mutual information is between specialY (Y_T) and the transcript M
conditioning is on the tuple (T, X_{≤T}, Y_{>T})
replaced: Bob's averaged fixed-coordinate information plus the entropy bound $H(M) ≤ ℓ$.
